Welcome to Online Permitting and Plan Review
for Planning & Development Services

To create a new account, click "New Account" at the top right corner of the page. Please do not create duplicate accounts.

Apply for Permit

Residential

Use the "Apply for Permit" option to submit for residential permits (examples below):

    York County permits are all-inclusive; sub-contractor permits are not issued – sub-contractors are noted on permits.
    The link for a checklist of required documents is available HERE.

  • Electric, HVAC, Gas and Plumbing Permits (MPEG)
  • Residential Permits:
  • .....House
  • .....Detached garages/workshops/barns
  • .....Inground swimming pools
  • .....Additions to existing house, decks

Create Project

Commercial

Use the "Create Project" option to submit for plan review and permits for commercial projects, zoning permits,
variances, and rezonings (examples below):

Civil/Site Construction Plans

  • Commercial Building Plans
  • Interior Upfit or Renovation Plans
  • Multi-family or Apartment Plans
  • Single family Subdivision Plans – Preliminary Plats, Final Plats, Construction Drawings

Zoning

  • Zoning Board of Appeals – Variances and Administrative Appeals
  • Rezoning Applications
  • Zoning Verification Requests
  • Sign Permits
  • Lake Wylie Buffer Approval
  • Individual Plat Approval

Contact us at 803-909-7200 or by email at permit.services@yorkcountygov.com
